method: Static disassembly (Apple LLVM objdump) and exported-symbol reads; nothing executed. Android libasobidroid.so read from the split archives; iOS executables from the analysis copies matched in releases.json.

select_candidate.code: #define SELECT_CANDIDATE_TIMEOUT_SEC 0.5F / #define SELECT_CANDIDATE_TRIES 20 (resend to all candidates until first response)
select_candidate.author: Street Pea

select_candidate.code: up to 20 rounds, each sending to all candidates then poll 500 ms; 1.1.1 rewrite keeps 20 rounds x 500 ms

random_allocation_sockets.code: loop of 250: socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0); setsockopt(SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT); bind; O_NONBLOCK

random_allocation_sockets.where: before the 'additional sockets for random allocation' log, three code paths each
random_allocation_sockets.code: 1.1.8 sets 250; 1.5 caps the count at min(n, 250)

select_candidate.note: No 20-round / 500 ms loop found with the encodings searched; not established on iOS (not shown absent).

ios_ps_remote_play_9_5_0.rudp_seed: absent: no 0x5E00/0x5C01 operand; its rand() calls in sce::rudp feed a hash, not a counter

windows_ps_remote_play_9_5_0_08040.rudp_seed: absent: the 8 0x5E00/0x5C01 hits are data misdecoded as code (enter/retf/out); no +0x1FF or +0x8000 add

ps_app_26_9_2.rudp_0x244F244F_framing: absent (sce::rudp used for party chat only)

sony_controls.limit: None of these Sony clients uses the RUDP framing chiaki-ng implements (0x244F244F), so they show Sony's clients do not use these values but cannot exclude that the values were observed from another Sony device's traffic (for example PS Portal).

not_matched: Android analyze_nat uses a generic equal-differences test and clamps to 1024..65535 (not chiaki-ng's case analysis or wrap rule)
Android has no 75-guess list; RUDP retries 5 vs chiaki-ng 3; birthday sockets use protocol 0 and no TTL-2 step
0x5e00 in Android 1.0.3/1.1.1 InternetPlaySession code is part of 0xb2d05e00 (3 s in ns), not the RUDP seed
